categories.label: Stimulants
categories.description: Substances that tend to increase alertness and physiological activity.

categories.label: Dissociatives
categories.description: Substances that can alter sensory integration and connection to surroundings.

categories.label: Psychedelics
categories.description: Substances that can substantially alter perception, thought, and mood.

expected: Stay with the person and keep checking how they respond.
Move somewhere calm and away from traffic, water, heights, or crowds.
payAttention: Confusion, agitation, repeated vomiting, severe headache, or behavior that is rapidly changing.
Breathing that is unusual, very fast, very slow, noisy, or difficult.
getHelp: Call emergency services now if they are unconscious, cannot be woken, have trouble breathing, have a seizure, collapse, or are dangerously hot.
Put an unconscious but breathing person on their side. If they are not breathing, begin CPR if you can.
Tell responders what may have been taken, when, and whether more than one substance may be involved. You will still get guidance if you do not know.
emergency.unknown: You do not need to know the substance or dose. Treat observable signs and call for help when in doubt.

substances.name: 2C-B
substances.identity: A synthetic psychedelic phenethylamine with stimulant-like and perception-altering effects.

safetyClaims.title: Identity and potency may be uncertain
safetyClaims.body: Products sold as 2C-B can be misrepresented, and relatively small quantity differences may change intensity.
safetyClaims.action: Treat appearance and seller claims as uncertain; avoid combinations and seek help for severe signs.

substances.name: Ketamine
substances.identity: A dissociative anaesthetic that can alter perception, coordination, memory, and connection to the body and surroundings.

safetyClaims.title: Reduced awareness and breathing need attention
safetyClaims.body: Heavy sedation, vomiting, and loss of coordination can become dangerous, especially with alcohol, opioids, or other depressants.
safetyClaims.action: Do not leave a heavily sedated person alone; call emergency services if they cannot be woken or breathing is abnormal.

doseReferences.context: A descriptive range is not a safe or recommended dose. Product identity, tolerance, technique, and individual response vary.

timelines.uncertainty: Route, amount, tolerance, product contents, and combinations change timing.

items: Detachment, altered movement, time, sound, and body perception
Nausea, confusion, memory gaps, falls, and unconsciousness
Setting, tolerance, route, and combinations can substantially change effects

helpSigns.body: Cannot be woken, abnormal breathing, seizure, collapse, or repeated vomiting while very drowsy

substances.name: MDMA
substances.identity: A synthetic psychoactive substance with stimulant and perception-altering effects, often associated with increased sociability and emotional openness.

safetyClaims.title: Dangerous overheating can happen
safetyClaims.body: Hot environments, sustained exertion, and other substances can increase strain. A person who is very hot, confused, collapses, or has a seizure needs emergency help.
safetyClaims.action: Stop exertion, move to a cooler place, stay together, and call emergency services for severe signs.

safetyClaims.title: Interactions can be serious
safetyClaims.body: Some medicines and substances can add serotonergic, cardiovascular, or overheating risk. The contents of products sold as MDMA are also uncertain.
safetyClaims.action: Avoid mixing; seek qualified medication advice rather than stopping prescribed medication yourself.

doseReferences.context: Descriptive published/observed ranges are not a safe or recommended dose. Potency, contents, body, medicines, setting, and individual response vary.
doseReferences.redosing: Effects can still be developing when someone considers taking more. Repeated dosing increases cumulative exposure and can prolong unwanted effects.

timelines.uncertainty: Food, contents, dose, metabolism, medicines, redosing, and other substances can shift these ranges.

items: Increased energy, sociability, sensory intensity, and emotional openness
Faster heart rate, jaw tension, sweating, and reduced appetite
Anxiety, nausea, overheating, confusion, insomnia, and low mood afterward
Contents and potency are not knowable from appearance
Environment, exertion, hydration, health, medicines, and combinations matter

testing.summary: A reagent reaction can be consistent with the presence of MDMA; it does not confirm identity, purity, dose, or rule out additional substances.
reactions: Marquis: a rapid dark purple-to-black reaction is reported as consistent with an MDxx-type substance, not confirmation of MDMA.
testing.limitations: Use more than one appropriate reagent and compare against current instructions. Laboratory analysis offers stronger identification where available.

helpSigns.body: Very high body temperature or hot skin with confusion
Collapse, seizure, severe agitation, chest pain, or difficulty breathing

relationships.reason: Sometimes encountered in the same settings; combined stimulant and dissociative effects can make impairment and warning signs harder to interpret.
Both may be sold in tablet or powder form and can be misrepresented; their effects and risk contexts are not interchangeable.

rabbitHole.body: MDMA increases signaling involving serotonin, norepinephrine, and dopamine. Serotonin-related effects are prominent, but no single transmitter explains the whole experience.

MDMA reverses monoamine transporter flow and affects neuroendocrine systems. Human experience depends on dose, context, expectations, and uncertain product contents, so mechanism is not a prediction of an individual's response.

substances.name: Psilocybin mushrooms
substances.identity: Fungi containing psilocybin whose potency and effects vary by species, specimen, preparation, person, and setting.

safetyClaims.title: Mushroom identification errors can be dangerous
safetyClaims.body: Appearance alone is not a reliable way to identify a mushroom; poisonous species can be mistaken for psychoactive ones.
safetyClaims.action: Do not consume unidentified wild mushrooms. Contact emergency or poison services after a suspected poisonous mushroom exposure.

safetyClaims.title: Distress and unsafe behavior can occur
safetyClaims.body: Perceptual and psychological effects can become overwhelming or disorienting.
safetyClaims.action: Move to a calm, safer setting, reduce stimulation, and stay with a distressed person.

timelines.uncertainty: Species, specimen, preparation, food, amount, person, and setting can shift timing and intensity.

items: Changes in perception, time, emotion, and thought
Anxiety, panic, confusion, nausea, and impaired judgment
Natural material can vary substantially even within one batch

helpSigns.body: Seizure, collapse, dangerous behavior, severe confusion, or suspected poisonous mushroom ingestion
